responsibility: Provides MIR dataflow infrastructure and the analyses built on it. At the top level it reexports the framework and concrete analyses and defines shared configuration/support types; the framework submodule supplies the generic analysis API, lattice/domain abstractions, execution direction semantics, fixpoint engine, result cursor and visitor reconstruction interfaces, formatting helpers, Graphviz rendering, and tests for reconstruction behavior. The move_paths submodule builds and owns the canonical move-path representation of MIR places, moves, and initializations, while drop_flag_effects derives the initialization/deinitialization effects on those paths needed for drop elaboration. On top of this, the impls submodule collects concrete MIR analyses for borrows and borrowed locals, local and place initialization state, liveness, and storage liveness, using MoveData and drop-flag effects to support borrow checking, generator/const reasoning, and drop elaboration.
